notes.title: Zombie Rampage Launch Month Free-To-Play Update
notes.notes: Zombie Rampage Free-To-Play Launch Month Is Coming To An End, It Will Last From 4 April - 30 April 2022, We Need Money To Fund The Games We Are Currently Developing And Those We'll Make In The Future To Be Able To Produce Games With Better Higher Quality, A Lot Of Time And Energy Was Spent To Create This Title, Zombie Rampage will be charged Anywhere Between $7.99 - $9.99, Those Who Already Own The Game Will Be Unaffected By This Change, This Money Goes Into Making Higher Quality Games Moving Forward, As It Will Assist In Acquiring Free-Lance Help, Buying Ready-Made Models, Licensing Songs And Hiring Voice-Actors. It Will Also Be Spent To Make Zombie Rampage 2 And Zombie Rampage 3 Future Titles. IMS Death Squad Is The Game Currently In Main Development And Will Have A October-November 2022 Release Window It Takes Place At Same Time As The Original Super Incursion. Without Sufficient Money The Scale And Quality Of Games We Can Produce Is Limited.
